name: first_outreach_email
description: Initial email contact on email with a potential candidate
prompt: Generate a professional outreach email introducing the job opportunity. Include how you found their profile, briefly describe the role and key benefits, and request their interest with a clear call-to-action.

name: first_outreach_linkedin
description: Initial LinkedIn contact with a potential candidate
prompt: Create a concise LinkedIn message introducing the job opportunity. Keep it brief but engaging, mention the role title and company, highlight one key benefit, and ask if they're open to learning more.

name: initial_follow_up_email
prompt: Write a follow-up email for a previous outreach. Reference the initial contact, reiterate the opportunity value, address potential concerns about timing, and encourage a response with a soft approach.

name: interview_scheduling
prompt: Create an email to schedule an interview. Congratulate them on moving forward, provide interview details (format, duration, participants), offer scheduling options, and include any preparation materials or next steps.

name: positive_interview_feedback
prompt: Generate a positive post-interview email. Thank them for their time, share specific positive feedback from the interview, outline next steps in the process, and provide timeline expectations.

name: rejection
prompt: Write a respectful rejection email. Thank them for their time and interest, provide brief feedback if appropriate, encourage them to apply for future opportunities, and maintain a positive relationship.

description: Create your own AI generation instructions

name: candidate_presentation
prompt: Create a professional candidate presentation email. Introduce the candidate with their key qualifications, highlight how they match the job requirements, include relevant background details, and recommend next steps.

name: interview-scheduling
prompt: Generate an email to coordinate interview scheduling with the client. Present the candidate briefly, propose interview format and timing options, clarify interview panel requirements, and request confirmation.

name: offer-negotiation
prompt: Write an email regarding offer negotiations. Present the candidate's feedback professionally, outline specific negotiation points (salary, benefits, start date), provide market context if relevant, and suggest resolution paths.

name: follow-up
prompt: Create a follow-up email to check on hiring process status. Reference previous submissions or conversations, request updates on candidate evaluation, offer additional support, and maintain engagement.
